evidence.title: Animated Components for React Native & Expo Apps

name: ScratchCard
summary: Scratch-to-reveal card component for React Native: a canvas you scratch off with a pan gesture to show hidden content.
description: A self-contained, copy-paste React Native component: ScratchCard.Behind holds the hidden content and ScratchCard.Overlay the layer the user scratches off with a pan gesture. Custom container styling and dynamic layout sizes; requires Skia, Reanimated and Gesture Handler.
contains: scratch-off effect driven by a pan gesture
customizable overlay and hidden behind content
self-contained single file — copy ScratchCard.tsx into your project
requires React Native Skia, Reanimated and Gesture Handler
MIT, part of the NicheGuys animated components collection
